content.title: Paige Bueckers confirms she and Azzi Fudd are girlfriends - Outsports
content.text: July 18 update: Paige Bueckers confirmed she and former UConn teammate Azzi Fudd are girlfriends. The reveal came in a cute TikTok video posted by WAGTalk at the WNBA All-Star Game. How well do you know your D1 girlfriend? Bueckers was asked, followed by a series of questions and ending with this exchange: WAGTalk: “What does her phone case say on it?” Bueckers: “It says: ‘Paige Bueckers’ girlfriend.'” WAGTalk: “Girlfriend reveal, it’s …” Bueckers: “Azzi Fudd.” Original article: Dallas Wings rookie Paige Bueckers and her former UConn teammate Azzi Fudd are becoming more public about their relationship, ratcheting up public interest with Bueckers figuratively panting following Fudd’s appearance on the red carpet at Wednesday’s ESPY Awards. On Instagram, Bueckers posted a story that showed a photo of Fudd wearing a lavender sleeveless dress at the ESPY’s, complete with three panting emojis, which caused a user on X to post: “Hungry huh?” Get off the sidelines and into the game Our weekly newsletter is packed with everything from locker room chatter to pressing LGBTQ sports issues. Then on Thursday, Bueckers posted a carousel of photos on Instagram that included her and Fudd sitting side by side in sweats on a couch. This comes on the heels of an Instagram post by Fudd a month ago that included a mirror selfie in the post that displays the phrase “Paige Bueckers’ Girlfriend” on her phone case, leading fans to view it as a hard launch of their relationship. Despite the two women not publicly using the words “gay” or “lesbian” or “girlfriends,” their social media posts on TikTok and Instagram basically confirm it. It’s part of the trend we have been seeing in recent years, which we dub “quietly coming out.” Connecticut guard Azzi Fudd (35) and guard Paige Bueckers (5) helped the Huskies win the NCAA title this spring. | Lucas Boland-Imagn Images The trend is more pronounced with female LGBTQ athletes, whose relationships with other women have been way more accepted and less scrutinized than those of men. Male athletes seem to be totally out or not, while many queer women occupy a space where they can be out without having to announce it. As the top pick in the recent WNBA draft, Bueckers is a major star, and Fudd was part of a championship-winning UConn team, so their relationship is getting attention. But it’s not nearly the amount had a top NBA player been open about a relationship with a man. It’s why in compiling our list of out LGBTQ Olympians in Paris, we combed through social media accounts of athletes and found a slew of women living openly on social media and no men. It’s great that Bueckers and Fudd have found each other and that they are allowed to share as much of it they want with the public. It is progress.
